glossary.definition: The point where the grid measures the electricity a home takes and gives back; a supplier needs it to supply the home.
In many European markets, the 18-digit number that names a metering point; this example calls it metering_point_id, and a utility maps it to the number its market uses.
A customer who also produces electricity at home, for example with solar panels, and sends what they do not use to the grid.
The price per kWh the supplier pays a prosumer for the electricity the home sends to the grid.
The child workflow that checks the installation's documents, gets the grid operator's approval and registers the export meter and tariff.
The move of a home's supply from its current supplier to the new one, which the registry of metering points carries out and confirms.
The customer's signed permission for the supplier to collect each bill from their bank account.
The installer's report that a home installation, such as solar panels, was set up and tested, with its serial numbers and rated capacity.

silence-switch.action: Add a touchpoint “Switch update”: a short message on day 7 of the switch, and at once when the registry is late. The letters agent writes it under the existing guardrail.

handover-first-failure.title: Hand an unreadable document to a person at the first failure

routing-allowed.action: Offer a task only to the people the policy allows: credit referrals to credit officers, and grid approvals to an engineer who neither resolved the file nor approved it already.

wait-plan-confirmed.title: Call before the plan offer lapses, on day 7
wait-plan-confirmed.action: Bring the phone call forward: wait 7 days for “plan.confirmed” before Confirm plan by phone, not 14.

remind-earlier.action: Send the reminder after 3 days, and let it say exactly which document is missing.

chase-switch-completed.title: Chase the registry before the switch times out
chase-switch-completed.action: Add a timer on the switch wait at day 14 that opens a task for the switching team to chase the registry, before the 21-day deadline.

cost-verify-documents.title: Try a lighter model for clear document checks

rules.title: Offer a payment plan before declining
rules.finding: {names}: declined on an energy debt above the limit and told by post. The journey ends there, the only customer lost at Application.
rules.action: Above the debt limit, offer a payment plan with a credit officer before the decline letter.

effect.text: Not measurable by replay: the path is new. Run it as a pilot and measure the customers who leave at Application.
